source_title: District of Columbia DOT — Oversize/Overweight Permits
verify_reasons: Legal dimension limits are statutory and high-confidence; the escort matrix here is a regional planning default (NOT read from this state's manual) and fees are not codified — confirm the exact escort thresholds, superload definition, current fee schedule and movement curfews with the state permit office before dispatch.

The District of Columbia is highly restrictive: DDOT reviews oversize moves case-by-case, police (MPD) escorts are common, and there is no simple published dimensional table. Treat everything here as verify_with_state and coordinate directly with DDOT.

superload_thresholds.note: DC does not publish a simple dimensional superload table; large loads require case-by-case DDOT review (and often MPD escort). Handler will flag for verification rather than clear.

width.note: DC planning default: DDOT/MPD escorts are commonly required for oversize movement in the District — confirm exact requirement with DDOT

single_trip.note: Single-trip OS/OW permit available; fee not codified here — quote through the state permit portal.

annual.note: Annual/blanket permits available for qualifying divisible or repetitive moves; fees vary — see portal.

movement_restrictions: DC restricts oversize movement to specific off-peak windows and requires DDOT coordination (and often MPD police escort). Confirm the current window and escort requirement with DDOT before any move.
notes: State-level rules only — county/city permits, bridge-specific engineering and low-clearance routing are out of scope. Knowledge-based entry pending point verification against the state manual.
